title: Throughput-Optimal Scheduling Algorithms for LLM Inference and AI Agents
authors: J.G. Dai; Tianze Deng; Yueying Li; Tianyi Peng
affiliations: Cornell University, University of Chicago Booth, Columbia Business School
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, Continuous batching, Capacity planning, Performance modeling, Queueing theory

problem_statement.en: Practitioners adopt LLM inference schedulers (FasterTransformer, vLLM, Orca, Sarathi-Serve) without a principled theoretical framework for evaluating throughput optimality and stability across workloads, models, and hardware.
problem_statement.zh: 實務上 FasterTransformer、vLLM、Orca、Sarathi-Serve 等 LLM 推理 scheduler 缺乏可比較吞吐量最佳性與穩定性的原則性理論架構，難以在不同工作負載、模型與硬體間進行嚴謹評估。

key_innovation.en: A queueing-theoretic framework with a fluid-limit analysis for multi-class batched processing networks under K-FCFS scheduling. Models batch processing time as a piecewise constant function of token load and proves that all work-conserving iteration-level schedulers achieve maximum throughput, while non-work-conserving schedulers (FasterTransformer, vanilla vLLM) are not maximally stable.
key_innovation.zh: 提出 LLM 推理的 queueing theory 架構，並對 K-FCFS scheduling 下的多類別批次處理網路發展 fluid-limit 分析。將 batch 處理時間建模為 token load 的 piecewise constant 函式，證明所有 work-conserving 的 iteration-level scheduler 皆達吞吐量最佳性，而非 work-conserving scheduler（FasterTransformer 與 vanilla vLLM）並非最大穩定。

key_improvements.en: Theoretical: proves Orca and Sarathi-Serve are throughput-optimal and FasterTransformer/vanilla vLLM are unstable under moderate load. Empirical: under Poisson arrivals (14 queries/s, 129 prefill + 112 decode tokens) on CodeLlama-34B with A100, queues in FasterTransformer and vLLM diverge while Sarathi-Serve stays stable; piecewise constant model attains R^2 above 0.97 across configurations.
key_improvements.zh: 理論上證明 Orca 與 Sarathi-Serve 為吞吐量最佳，FasterTransformer 與 vanilla vLLM 在中等負載下不穩定。實驗上以 CodeLlama-34B 在 A100、Poisson 到達率 14 queries/s（prefill 129、decode 112 tokens）測試，FasterTransformer 與 vLLM 佇列發散，Sarathi-Serve 維持穩定；piecewise constant 模型於各設定下 R^2 皆超過 0.97。

reported_accuracy: R^2 > 0.97 for piecewise constant batch-time fit
validation_workloads: Synthetic (Poisson arrivals), Production code traces (Patel et al. 2023), ShareGPT

scope_assumptions.en: Focuses on throughput aspect; SLO attainment left as future work. Batch processing time approximated as piecewise constant in token load, requiring measured constants per model and tensor-parallel configuration. Cyclic routing topologies and batch-size constraints can void throughput-optimality even for work-conserving algorithms. AI-agent extension assumes DAG/fork-join routing.
scope_assumptions.zh: 聚焦於吞吐量分析，SLO 達成留待後續工作。將 batch 處理時間近似為 token load 的 piecewise constant，需依模型與 tensor parallelism 設定量測常數。在 cyclic routing 拓樸與 batch size 限制下，即使 work-conserving 演算法亦可能失去吞吐量最佳性。AI-agent 延伸假設 DAG 或 fork-join routing。
